name: Freedom In Christ
overview: Scripture reveals that true freedom is found exclusively in Christ, who has been anointed to proclaim liberty to the captives and release those bound by sin (Isaiah 61:1). Knowing the truth of Christ sets believers free, and this freedom is complete and genuine when granted by the Son (John 8:32, 36). Believers are made free from sin and become servants to God, producing holiness and ultimately receiving eternal life (Romans 6:22). This freedom is characterized by walking according to the Spirit rather than the flesh, resulting in no condemnation for those in Christ Jesus (Romans 8:1), and is lived out by faith in the Son who loved and gave Himself for us (Galatians 2:20).
